topic: Explanation of helicopter autopilot system and various facilities available through it.
syllabus_extract: Explanation of helicopter autopilot system and various facilities available through it.
specific_objectives: 14.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the functions of AFCS.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of AFCS block diagram and facility list from IB; Instructor supervision during Q&A.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an autopilot system?
Name two manual flight controls used in a helicopter.
Why is an autopilot necessary for helicopter operations?

topics: Definition and basic principle of AFCS
development.content:
Definition and basic principle of AFCS
Sensors and data acquisition units
Control laws and stability augmentation
Actuator types and power sources
System integration with flight instruments

topics: Attitude hold and heading hold functions
Altitude hold and vertical speed control
development.content:
Attitude hold and heading hold functions
Altitude hold and vertical speed control
Yaw damping and turn coordination
Auto-hover and auto-landing facilities
Manual override and disengagement procedures

System limitations and failure modes
Maintenance requirements and checks
Operational restrictions during flight
Troubleshooting common AFCS faults
Future trends in helicopter automation

summary_questions: Explain how the AFCS maintains altitude during flight.
Describe the procedure for manually overriding the autopilot.
List three limitations of the current helicopter autopilot system.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the need for Flight Director Systems (FDS) as covered in the next lesson plan (LP 43), highlighting how it complements the AFCS.
